title: backlog.py run by its full path from a host project reads the plugin's own backlog.json, and the plugin's skills and brief show no --root (second-project run)
goal: A backlog.py command run from outside the tool's own checkout, by a host project's session on the plugin's full path, takes the git top level of its working directory as its root, so it reads the host's backlog.json and item directory and no host command reads or writes the kb's own backlog; run inside the kb's clone or a worktree of it, or given --root, the root stays what it is today

run: import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile,json; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d]); open(os.path.join(d,'backlog.json'),'w').write(json.dumps({'item_dir':'host_items'})); o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,os.path.abspath('_tools/backlog.py'),'config'],cwd=d,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; sys.exit(0 if 'item_dir = "host_items"' in o else 1)

import sys,os; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bl_cli; r=os.path.realpath('.'); a=os.path.realpath(bl_cli.default_root(r, cwd=os.path.join(r,'_tools')))==r; b=bl_cli.root_of(['--root','/x','config'],'/y')=='/x'; sys.exit(0 if a and b else 1)

gates.question: How does a backlog.py command a host project runs by the plugin path find the host root?
options: default root is the working tree git top level whenever the tool runs from outside it
the skills and the brief pass --root on every command
gates.recommendation: default root is the working tree git top level whenever the tool runs from outside it
gates.answer: default root is the working tree git top level whenever the tool runs from outside it

notes: Run in a host with the plugin's full path: config printed item_dir = "kb/_self/backlog" (file), so a host worker's gate add without --root writes the kb's backlog; with --plugin-dir <kb clone> a host's backlog.json hooks key is never read. Blocks the Nerthus adoption (BG-42dg5ryi's host); P1 by the operator. Planned to the operator's answer (the git top level of the working directory is the root outside the tool's checkout). Ran the rewritten repro (plants backlog.json item_dir host_items in a git-init dir, runs the plugin's backlog.py config there): exit 1, output item_dir = "kb/_self/backlog" (file). The guard check passes now: default_root from inside the checkout gives the checkout, --root wins. Fix is bl_cli.default_root (bl_cli.py:126), which returns the tool root whenever it holds .git; its only caller is backlog.py:402; kb_mcp.py has its own root_of. Docs: the settings paragraph of backlog.md that spells the root order, and tools.md, by the map rows for bl_*.py.

run: import sys,os; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bl_cli; r=os.path.realpath('.'); a=os.path.realpath(bl_cli.default_root(r, cwd=os.path.join(r,'_tools')))==r; b=bl_cli.root_of(['--root','/x','config'],'/y')=='/x'; sys.exit(0 if a and b else 1)
